s2:The S4G-WISE View of Global Star Formation in the Nearby Universe

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the underlying causes of discrepancies in SFR measurements and their relationship with dust attenuation across different galaxy samples, nor do they address the specific tensions in the values of Q and the bimodal age distribution of stars.
